### 💡 Feature Summary
A clear and concise description of the suggested feature or app.

### ❓ Is your feature related to a problem or limitation?
A clear description of what problem this solves or what is missing.

### 🚀 Proposed Solution / Design
Describe how you imagine this feature working (e.g., UI layout, animations, new macOS app ideas).

### 🔄 Alternative Solutions
Any alternative ideas or approaches considered.

### 📎 Additional Context
Add any relevant mockups, references, or screenshots.
